newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong stocks close morning sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks close morning sharply higher.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks closed Friday morning sharply higher in a technical rebound but gains could be trimmed this afternoon on lack of good liquidity, brokers said.
The Hang Seng Index surged 240.75 points, or 1.62 percent, to 15,079.98, off the morning high of 15,135.77. Turnover was at HK$10.68 billion versus Thursday midday's HK$8.31 billion.
"It's purely a technical rebound and sentiment on both red and blue chips improved, but liquidity failed to pick up," said Tony Ying, research director at Tai Fook Securities Co Ltd.
Upcoming pre-sales of several major residential developments boosted blue chip property stocks, he added.
